title: Chapter 855
paragraphs: Chapter 855
Episode 213. The Rift, A Precursor to a Major Change (2)
"Lord Ameris, is there a way to close the rift?"
"Look closely at the center of the rift, Jin."
".... It's cloudy and not clearly visible, but I see a violet pattern."

"That pattern represents the purple bellflower of the Demon Realm, symbolizing Zito. In other words, this is a magic directly cast by Zito. There aren't many beings or means that can break his magic."
At that, Jin drew his sword, Brada-Mante, and wrapped it in spirit energy.
"Are you thinking of cutting it with your spirit sword?"
"Yes, Lord Ameris. But... as soon as I decided to cut the rift, a strange discomfort arose."

"You felt it instinctively. Cutting the rift with your spirit sword might be possible. However, you would suffer a tremendous blow. Your incapacitation requiring rest and healing would be extremely dangerous for the entire Vamel Union."
Jin withdrew his spirit energy and shrugged his shoulders. As Ameris said, his current health was directly linked to the defense of the Vamel Union.
'When I tried to cut the rift... I felt as if Zito's will was trying to entangle me like a thorny bush. I could probably break it, but as Ameris said, I would take a significant blow.'
The fact that he could feel such a degree of danger just from the 'act of breaking the rift' showed the unimaginable power Zito himself had.
"Only the full power of the Creator, or a power or authority of equivalent level, would be able to destroy the rift without much difficulty."
"Huh, then let me, Murakan, give it a breath."
"No, Murakan. You might get hurt if you provoke the rift for nothing. Even though you've almost regained your old power, you're not as perfect as you were back then, are you?"
"Ah, you've hit a sore spot."
The one who felt the greatest sense of powerlessness was Dante.
"It's bitter. I feel like I won't be able to cut the rift like you or Lord Murakan, even if I overdo it."
"In my opinion, you could do it, Dante. You'll just get hurt a bit more than me or the little guy."
"Besides, this is the territory of the Empire... Are you saying that the best thing to do is to leave it alone?"

"Dante, in my eyes, you're already an excellent, no, a great leader. Leaving it alone means not taking any action. From now on, aren't you going to evacuate your people living here and provide them with new homes and jobs?"
"That's right, Lord Ameris."

"Even if you, Murakan, and Jin, the most important forces of the Union, have to risk danger to cut the rift, it should only be done where more lives and values are at stake. I'm talking about areas where we cannot minimize damage just by evacuating the residents, as we are doing now. From now on, countless rifts like these will appear all over the world. Perhaps new reports are already being filed."
What if they had used their power to eliminate the rift in the realm of Romf out of anger, only for larger rifts to occur in Tikan or the old capital of the Empire?
Those lands could never solve the problem just by evacuating the people.
"Evacuate all the people of Romf to the old capital."
Dante instructed the scribe who came with him.
"Understood, Lord."
"Make sure to tell them I'm sorry I couldn't protect their homes. Demon Realm, Zipple, Kinzelo... When all the wars are over, I will make sure that my people will never have to leave their land."
Ameris patted the shoulder of Dante, who was gritting his teeth and glaring at the rift.

"Don't blame yourself too much, Dante. Although the people of Romf who are leaving have lost their land, no one has died. It's thanks to your quick action. If we had arrived here only after something popped out of the rift, there would have been no survivors. Or the same would be true if we hadn't taken proper action like we did now."
The residents of Romf immediately began to evacuate under the control of the Meltador army.

The party returned to Tikan and the Second City of Hairan immediately and declared a state of emergency throughout each force and issued orders. It was an order to evacuate as soon as a rift occurred.
Not even ten days had passed since they confirmed the first rift in Romf, but new reports about the rift were continuously being filed.
"This time it's Balronso, the base of Kurano Republic... It's already the second time for the Kurano Republic."
Now, Tikan was in a state of saturation. From the beginning, after the Gliyak war, there had been a continuous influx of immigration applications from all over the world to Tikan.
"Please choose appropriate regions and process the immigration for each area, King."
"Understood, Duke."
"How is the situation in Zipple?"

"According to an anonymous report, transference rifts continue to occur in the Rutero Federation. There was a big defeat in a recent battle with the Red Name tribe. It's speculated that it's probably because Elona Zipple was absent dealing with the rifts."
"It seems we can't easily get rid of the rifts with the current Devil Stone. Please tell the anonymous source to find out the exact number of rifts in the federation if possible."

It felt like bombs, which could explode at any time, kept sprouting from the ground. Although there have been no casualties due to the rifts yet, and there are enough resources to support the refugees.
This state couldn't continue forever. The land and resources are all limited, and they will eventually run out.
"I'm so frustrated..."
As time passed, Jin realized how dangerous his attempt to cut the rift in Romf had been.
'If I had been hurt trying to cut the rift in Romf, I wouldn't have been able to fight when people really needed me.'
At that moment, the communication device in the Tikan conference room rang. It was a call from Runcandel, the Garden of Swords.
Jin was engulfed by a bad premonition that what he had been dreading had finally come.
{Deputy.}
"Speak, Chief Steward."
{A massive transference rift has occurred in Xiatello.}
Xiatello was one of the main cities of Huphester, not far from 'Calron', where the Garden of Swords was located.
Naturally, its residential population was among the highest in Huphester, and losing Xiatello was like handing over a base to the Demon Realm near the Garden of Swords.
"....Massive?"

{Yes, and it is quite different from most of the rifts reported recently. As I said, it is much larger, and a sort of shockwave continues to radiate from the rift. Fortunately, there is no significant loss of life since the rift occurred on the outskirts, but its spread is not ordinary.}
Click! Jin clenched his teeth without even realizing it.
"I'll depart immediately."
Jin immediately headed to the departure platform of the Red Owl with Murakan and Ameris. At the departure platform were Dr. Qwal and Valeria, who had returned to Tikan for a while this morning.
Moreover, the Red Owl was in a state where a significant number of parts had been disassembled.
"Oh, Jin. Do you need to take off right now?"
"Is there a problem, Dr. Qwal?"
"Have you forgotten why I came here this morning? The Red Owl has been severely damaged due to frequent sorties lately. Without proper maintenance, the power source would have been blown off."
"A massive rift has occurred in Xiatello right now. We must go immediately."
"Damn it, in Xiatello? The maintenance is almost finished. But it will take at least two hours to complete the assembly of the parts..."
"Can't you do it faster?"
"Two hours is the fastest speed that Valeria and I can offer. If you go faster than that, you'll end up stuck somewhere in subspace."
"Jin, we can't help it. Please wait a little. Or it might be a good idea to contact Hidden Palace and ask for the assistance of the Little Archer."
As Valeria suggested, Jin immediately requested communication with Hidden Palace.

"Oh, Deputy? It's Peng. The Little Archer is currently patrolling the sea with Mort... because rifts are forming one by one here too. What? It's super urgent? A massive rift in Xiatello? Oh no, what should we do!? It will take some time for us to figure out the exact location of the Little Archer."

A surge of anger welled up in his frustrated heart. The longer he delayed, the more damage Xiatello would suffer. He was driven mad by the imagined scenes of ordinary people and the knights of the families trying to protect them dying.

[Deputy, I will continue to report as I get updates from Xiatello. It's only two hours, so don't worry too much. We've already dispatched the Black Sword Chairman and the riders first, so there shouldn't be a big problem.]
Jin sat in front of the communication device, suppressing his anxious mind.

Ruet was just as anxious. If a base of the Demon Realm were to be summoned to Xiatello before Jin arrives, Huphester would have to immediately enter a war with the Demon Realm. Balas, Mary, and the Tona brothers did not have the power to destroy the rift.
'So far, nothing has ever been summoned right after a rift formed... but I have a bad feeling. I get the feeling that the Demon Realm intentionally chose Xiatello to create a massive rift.'

If the Demon Realm knew about the geographical features of Inse, Xiatello was an excellent place to occupy. From the moment a city of the Demon Realm was summoned, it was a region that could immediately attack the Garden of Swords.
In the end, Hidden Palace could not find Syris and Mort even after two hours passed.
{I'm sorry, Deputy. We've set off all kinds of flares, but I guess the Little Archer didn't check because she was patrolling far-off areas of the Western Sea.}
"It's okay, Peng. If there are any other problems, communicate to Tikan immediately."
At the launch pad, the Red Owl was ready, having finished its maintenance. Qwal and Valeria were exhausted.
"Thank you for your hard work, Dr. Qwal, Valeria. I'll be back."
As soon as he started the Red Owl, he arrived in Xiatello in no time.

And the massive rift that had formed in Xiatello was much larger than Jin had anticipated. The violet rift filled the outskirts of Xiatello, and the knights were fighting with violet ghost-like entities.
"Jin, those are monsters formed by the will of the ground that created the rift. They're troublesome..."
The moment Ameris explained this,
Jin looked beyond the rift where the knights were struggling. There stood five people he had not expected at all.
"Kid, what's up? Oh... Wow! Haven't seen that guy in a long time!?"
Murakan also belatedly identified them and shouted.
They were Luna and the former Black Knights, who had just arrived in Inse and were heading towards the Garden of Swords.
"Sister Luna...!"
"Oh, little one!"
The moment Luna and the former Black Knights looked up at the Red Owl,
Jin felt as if all the frustration he had felt was washed away in an instant.
